subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Single vs. Multi-Sourcing
description: A short lesson to help you apply Single vs. Multi-Sourcing.

hook.text: Toyota used a single supplier for a critical valve. When that factory burned down, production stopped worldwide.

buildup.text: Single sourcing gives one supplier all your volume. Multi-sourcing splits it across two or more.

discovery.text: Single sourcing builds deep relationships and economies of scale. Multi-sourcing reduces risk.

twist.text: Multi-sourcing costs more to manage and may prevent you from reaching the volume tiers that unlock discounts.

climax.text: After COVID exposed single-source risks, most companies now dual-source their top 20 critical items.

punchline.text: One supplier is a bet. Two is a strategy.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of single sourcing?
options: Total supply disruption if that supplier fails
